a: أَنَا عِنْدَ ظَنِّ عَبْدِي بِي وَأَنَا مَعَهُ حِينَ يَذْكُرُنِي فَإِنْ ذَكَرَنِي فِي نَفْسِهِ ذَكَرْتُهُ فِي نَفْسِي وَإِنْ ذَكَرَنِي فِي مَلإٍ ذَكَرْتُهُ فِي مَلإٍ خَيْرٍ مِنْهُمْ وَإِنِ اقْتَرَبَ إِلَىَّ شِبْرًا اقْتَرَبْتُ إِلَيْهِ ذِرَاعًا
p: Anā ʿinda ẓanni ʿabdī bī, wa anā maʿahu ḥīna yadhkurunī. Fa-in dhakaranī fī nafsihi dhakartuhu fī nafsī, wa in dhakaranī fī malaʾin dhakartuhu fī malaʾin khayrin minhum. Wa ini-qtaraba ilayya shibran-iqtarabtu ilayhi dhirāʿā
m: I am as My servant thinks of Me, and I am with him when he remembers Me. If he remembers Me to himself, I remember him to Myself. If he remembers Me in a gathering, I remember him in a better gathering. If he comes a hand's span nearer, I come a forearm nearer.
